By Andrew McCulloch ,
6 hours ago
From Knox City to Santa Anna and beyond, the 2026 six-man Texas high school football season is in full swing across the Big Country and West Texas.
Big Country and Abilene area schools are represented in 15 separate UIL six-man football districts this year – six in UIL Class 1A Division I, eight in Class 1A Division II and one in TAPPS.
Here’s a closer look at the district standings for every six-man district featuring Big Country area teams heading into the eighth week of the 2026 Texas high school football season:
